v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: Blessed are all * they that fear the Lord. ‡
Let them all be confounded * who hate Sion.

text.la: De profúndis * clamávi ad te, Dómine. ‡
text.en: Out of the depths * I have cried to thee, O Lord. ‡

text.la: Dómine, * non est exaltátum cor meum. ‡
text.en: O Lord * my heart is not exalted. ‡

text.la: Elégit Dóminus * Sion in habitatiónem sibi.
text.en: The Lord hath chosen * Sion for his dwelling.

text.la: Sicut fuit Ionas * in ventre ceti tribus diébus et tribus nóctibus, ita erit Fílius hóminis in corde terræ.
text.en: As Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly, * so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

text.la: Mentes nostras, quǽsumus, Dómine, lúmine tuæ claritátis illústra: ut vidére possímus quæ agénda sunt; et, quæ recta sunt, ágere valeámus.
text.en: O Lord, we beseech thee to cast thy bright beams of light upon our mind, that we may clearly see whatsoever things Thou wouldst have us to do, and have strength to do always that which is pleasing in thy sight.
